name: Perceptual Wrapper
definition: A plug-and-play 2D perceptual wrapper that enhances rendered outputs of existing 3DGS representations in a content- and view-dependent manner by leveraging a lightweight synthesis network conditioned on pseudo-random Gaussian noise.
summary: The Perceptual Wrapper is a plug-and-play 2D module that enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting outputs by synthesizing high-frequency texture details via a lightweight post-processing network, distinguishing itself by operating in the image domain rather than modifying 3D primitives.
